name: @kitty-crow/neru
description: Boot a kernel-only Linux-WASM runtime over the live mikuOS userspace.

scripts.build: npm run guards && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run check:runtime && python3 -m py_compile scripts/prepare-kernel.py scripts/prepare-userland.py scripts/make-rv64-smoke.py
scripts.test: npm run build && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.runtime.json TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node --loader ts-node/esm --test tests/*.test.mts
